produced_findings.claim: Off-by-one in page slice returns `page_size + 1` items Line 3 sets `end = offset + page_size + 1`, and line 4 slices `items[offset:end]`. The slice length is `page_size + 1` whenever enough items remain. For `items=[1..10]`, `page_number=1`, `page_size=3`, the result is `[1, 2, 3, 4]`. Page 2 starts at offset 3 and returns `[4, 5, 6, 7]`. Item 4 appears on both pages. The pre-image `items[offset : offset + page_size]` returned exactly `page_size` items. Every page returns one more item than requested and duplicates the first item of the following page. Consumers get duplicated records and violate the page-size contract. A caller that checks `len(result) == page_size` to detect a full page or the last page will misbehave. The defect affects every caller of `page()`.
